title: Basic properties of a vortex in a noncentrosymmetric superconductor
verdict: PARTIAL (strong): all four targeted observables reproduced using the paper's EXACT g_I +/- g_II decomposition. (1) Psi(r) and Delta(r) recover with the SAME core radius (1.50 xi0). (2) Large zero-bias LDOS core peak: N(E=0,r) maximal at r=0 (7.92 vs 4.96 far), core LDOS peaks at E=0; two-gap bulk DOS confirmed (fully-gapped sheet I far N(0)=0.60 vs line-node sheet II 4.36). (3) Supercurrent |j|~(g_I+g_II) ~0 at core, peaks at 1.12 xi0. (4) DISTINCTIVE radial magnetization |M|~(g_I-g_II) peaks at 1.38 xi0, ->0 far (~1e-17), and VANISHES identically in the equal-sheet control (Delta=0), isolating broken inversion symmetry. Reduced fixed-profile (non-self-consistent) order parameter -> PARTIAL rather than full REPLICATED. Note: an earlier draft used an incorrect scalar gz-weighted m_z proxy that failed; rewritten to the paper's exact g_I-g_II form (Eqs.7-9), which passes cleanly.
